color_palette.name: Voltage Black
color_palette.usage: Primary site background and card bases — the deep stage floor that makes every saturated color pop; used in nav, footer, hero backdrop, and all dark card surfaces across the card grid

color_palette.name: Reactor Yellow
color_palette.usage: The loudest hero color — primary CTA buttons, large date/event badges, stat callout numerals, and the BoltWorks wordmark highlight stroke; the electric anchor of the entire festival-poster energy

color_palette.name: Plasma Magenta
color_palette.usage: Bold gradient partner to Reactor Yellow; used in hero gradient overlays, department card header bands, active nav indicators, and hover states on primary CTAs to create the signature two-tone poster gradient

color_palette.name: Ignition Orange
color_palette.usage: Secondary accent for lineup-block borders, feature grid card top-edge rules, timeline node markers, and competition-round badges — adds a third saturated tone that deepens the gradient spectrum without muddying it

color_palette.name: Circuit Cyan
color_palette.usage: Tertiary saturated accent for research page stats, gallery caption chips, comparison table highlights, and tag/badge backgrounds on dark cards — provides cool contrast against the warm yellow-orange-magenta trio

color_palette.name: Poster Cream
color_palette.usage: High-legibility light surface for body copy blocks, FAQ panels, contact form fields, and any card interior that needs a warm off-white — evokes vintage festival poster paper stock without going sterile

color_palette.name: Crowd White
color_palette.usage: Maximum-contrast text on Voltage Black surfaces, card titles in the grid, hero tagline type, and icon fills — reserved for moments that need full luminance punch against the dark background

color_palette.name: Backstage Charcoal
color_palette.usage: Secondary dark surface for alternating card backgrounds, sidebar panels, stats section backdrop, and footer sub-sections — slightly cooler than Voltage Black to create subtle depth layering in the card grid

typography.heading_treatment: Archivo Black at aggressive display scale — H1 at 72–96px fully uppercase with ultra-tight tracking (-0.03em), H2 at 48–60px uppercase, H3 at 28–36px uppercase; all headings set in Crowd White or Reactor Yellow against dark surfaces, creating the condensed-sans bold hierarchy of a festival poster headline stack. Weight never drops below 800 for any heading level.
typography.body_treatment: Archivo Regular at 16–18px with a 1.65 line-height on Poster Cream or Crowd White surfaces; used for all descriptive copy, card body text, FAQ answers, and form labels. Archivo's grotesque geometry keeps the poster energy without sacrificing readability at paragraph scale.
typography.accent_treatment: Bebas Neue at 10–14px in full uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.15–0.25em) for eyebrow labels above section headings, lineup-block category tags, stat unit labels, badge text, and metadata chips — a condensed display face used exclusively at small accent scale to reinforce the festival-poster typographic vernacular without competing with Archivo Black at display size.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The BoltWorks Home page is a festival-poster landing experience built on a Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) base that never relents. The page reads like a concert program: loud, sequential, event-driven, with each section functioning as a distinct "lineup block" that alternates density and breathing room rather than repeating the same eyebrow→headline→CTA skeleton.

SECTION SEQUENCE & RHYTHM:
1. Hero — full-bleed, maximum amplitude, off-axis illustration overlapping into the viewport edge. Centered typographic stack but with a deliberate asymmetric illustration break.
2. Stats — a dense horizontal marquee-style band in Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A), oversized numerals as type-as-image, zero narrative copy — pure data as spectacle.
3. Feature Grid — 2×2 card grid on Voltage Black with top-edge color rules and tight lineup-block styling; moderate density with a clear CTA exit.
4. Timeline — a vertical spine layout with large date-badge nodes in Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) alternating left/right content blocks; the most editorial, highest-information section.
5. CTA Close — full-bleed Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) panel with a circuit-board pattern behind oversized black type; the loudest color moment on the page, a deliberate palette inversion.

SIGNATURE MOMENT:
The page's signature moment lives in the Hero (Section 1): the robot illustration is NOT contained inside a box or column — it bleeds off the right edge of the viewport and overlaps the stat band below, crossing the section boundary. The headline "BUILD. COMPETE. IGNITE." is set at 96px Archivo Black, fully uppercase, with ultra-tight tracking, split across three stacked lines where each word occupies its own line and the word "IGNITE." is stroked in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) while the others are Crowd White (#FFFFFF). This multi-line stacked display headline with a single-word color punch, combined with the illustration bleeding past the section edge, is the unmistakable festival-poster typographic stunt that defines the page.

COLOR & SURFACE LOGIC:
- Sections 1, 3: Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) — the dominant dark stage floor.
- Section 2: Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A) — a subtle cool shift that creates depth without breaking the dark mood.
- Section 4: Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) with Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) structural nodes.
- Section 5: Full-bleed Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) — the single warm light surface, reserved for maximum contrast impact at the close.
Reactor Yellow is NOT only on buttons — it appears on the headline word "IGNITE." in the hero, on stat numeral highlights, and as the entire background of Section 5. Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E) appears in the hero gradient overlay and on active/hover CTA states. Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF) appears as tag chips in the feature grid cards. Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) is structural — timeline nodes, card top-edge rules.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
- H1 (Hero): Archivo Black, 96px, uppercase, tracking -0.03em, Crowd White + Reactor Yellow accent word.
- H2 (Stats, Feature Grid, Timeline, CTA): Archivo Black, 56–64px, uppercase, tracking -0.02em.
- H3 (Card/item titles): Archivo Black, 28–32px, uppercase.
- Eyebrows: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em, Plasma Magenta or Circuit Cyan depending on surface.
- Body: Archivo Regular, 17px, 1.65 line-height, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC) on dark surfaces.
- Stat numerals: Archivo Black, 80–96px, Reactor Yellow on Backstage Charcoal — type-as-image treatment.
- Timeline date labels: Bebas Neue, 18px, uppercase, Ignition Orange.
- CTA Close headline: Archivo Black, 72–80px, uppercase, Voltage Black on Reactor Yellow.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
The page alternates between high-density bands (Stats: zero whitespace, edge-to-edge numerals; Feature Grid: tight card gutters) and more open compositions (Timeline: generous vertical rhythm between nodes; Hero: tall viewport height with breathing room around the headline stack). This push-pull mirrors a festival program's alternation between packed lineup pages and full-bleed artist spreads.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Mobile: Hero headline scales to 52px, single-column; illustration repositions to sit above the headline stack at 60% viewport width, no bleed. Stats stack vertically 2×2. Feature Grid collapses to single column. Timeline collapses to a left-aligned vertical rail with nodes on the left only. CTA Close maintains full-bleed yellow with headline scaling to 48px.
- Tablet: Hero illustration bleeds to right edge; stats 2×2 grid; feature grid 2×2; timeline alternating maintained.
- Desktop: Full-bleed illustration bleed, 4-stat horizontal band, 2×2 feature grid, alternating timeline, full-bleed CTA close.

This page fits the shared design system by using all eight palette tokens expressively, Archivo Black at aggressive display scale throughout, Bebas Neue for all eyebrow/badge/metadata moments, and Archivo Regular for all body copy. It is its own composition because the yellow-surface CTA close, the bleeding illustration signature, and the stat numerals-as-display-type are all moves that belong to festival-poster energy — not SaaS marketing templates.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
HERO SECTION — Full-bleed Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) background, viewport height of 100vh on desktop (90vh on mobile). The layout is intentionally asymmetric: the left 55% of the desktop viewport holds the typographic stack, the right 45% is dominated by the robot illustration asset that bleeds off the right viewport edge and extends slightly below the section fold, overlapping the stats band below by approximately 80px — this cross-section bleed is the page's SIGNATURE MOMENT and must not be contained.

TYPOGRAPHIC STACK (left-aligned, starting at roughly 15% from the left edge on desktop, 24px padding on mobile):
— Eyebrow: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E), set above the headline with 16px margin below. Text: 'WELCOME TO BOLTWORKS ROBOTICS CLUB'.
— Headline: Archivo Black, 96px on desktop / 52px on mobile, fully uppercase, tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.95, stacked across three lines — 'BUILD.' on line 1 in Crowd White (#FFFFFF), 'COMPETE.' on line 2 in Crowd White (#FFFFFF), 'IGNITE.' on line 3 in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600). This is the festival-poster typographic stunt: the single-word color punch on the final word is the defining visual move. No other element competes with this stack.
— Subheadline: Archivo Black, 22px on desktop / 18px on mobile, uppercase, tracking -0.01em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF), set 28px below the headline. Text: 'THE ARENA IS OPEN. YOUNG ENGINEERS, CODERS, AND MAKERS — YOUR ROBOT AWAITS.'
— Body copy: Archivo Regular, 17px, line-height 1.65, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC), set 20px below the subheadline, max-width 520px. Text: 'From first-time builders to seasoned competitors, BoltWorks is where sparks fly and ideas become machines. Join the most electrifying robotics club around.'
— CTA row: 40px below body copy. Two buttons side by side (stacked on mobile). Primary CTA 'Join the Club': Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) background, Voltage Black text, Archivo Black 15px uppercase, 18px vertical padding, 32px horizontal padding, no border radius (flat, poster-style sharp corners). On hover: background transitions to Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E), text stays Voltage Black. Secondary CTA 'See Our Programs': transparent background, 2px solid Crowd White (#FFFFFF) border, Crowd White text, same type treatment. On hover: border and text shift to Reactor Yellow (#FFE600). Gap between buttons: 16px.

ILLUSTRATION ASSET: The bold festival-poster robot silhouette with lightning bolt accents is placed in the right 45% of the desktop layout. It is vertically centered in the section but extends below the section's bottom edge by ~80px (z-index above the stats section background, creating the cross-section overlap). On the illustration, a Plasma Magenta-to-Reactor Yellow radial gradient overlay at 35% opacity is applied to the background zone behind the robot, creating the signature two-tone poster glow effect. On tablet, the illustration scales to 50% width and maintains the bleed. On mobile, the illustration is repositioned ABOVE the typographic stack, constrained to 70% viewport width, centered, no bleed — the gradient overlay is preserved.

Background treatment: Voltage Black solid. A subtle radial gradient from Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E) at 8% opacity emanates from the upper-right quadrant behind the illustration zone, adding depth without muddying the dark surface. No section divider at the bottom — the illustration bleed IS the visual transition into the stats band.

STATS SECTION — A dense, horizontal marquee-style band. Background: Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A). No top/bottom section padding beyond 48px vertical — this is a tight, compressed band, not a spacious section. The cool-dark surface shift from Voltage Black creates subtle depth layering.

EYEBROW: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF), centered above the stat grid. Text: 'BOLTWORKS BY THE NUMBERS'. Margin-bottom 12px.

HEADLINE: Archivo Black, 28px, uppercase, tracking -0.02em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF), centered. Text: 'A COMMUNITY THAT BUILDS BIG'. Margin-bottom 40px.

STAT GRID: 4 columns on desktop, 2×2 on tablet, 2×2 on mobile (no single-column collapse — the density is intentional even on mobile). Each stat cell is a vertical stack with zero card border — the stats float directly on the Backstage Charcoal surface with only the column gutter (32px) separating them. Stat cells are NOT cards with backgrounds; they are open type blocks.

For each stat cell:
— Numeral: Archivo Black, 88px on desktop / 64px on tablet / 56px on mobile, Reactor Yellow (#FFE600), tracking -0.03em, line-height 1.0. This is the type-as-image move — these numerals are the dominant visual element of the entire band, reading like a lineup announcement.
— Description: Archivo Regular, 15px, line-height 1.5, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC), set 8px below the numeral, max-width 180px per cell.

Stat values and descriptions:
1. '250+' / 'Active student members across all age divisions'
2. '18' / 'Competition trophies won in the last two seasons'
3. '12' / 'Specialized workshops and training tracks offered'
4. '6' / 'Partner schools and community organizations'

A thin 2px horizontal rule in Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) runs the full width of the section at the very bottom edge, acting as a lineup-block border that closes the band and introduces the feature grid below. No other decorative elements — the numerals carry all the visual weight.

Note: The hero illustration's bleed overlaps the top-left corner of this section on desktop. The stat content must be positioned so the '250+' numeral is not obscured — shift the stat grid 8% right of center on desktop to account for the illustration overlap zone.

FEATURE GRID SECTION — Background: Voltage Black (#0D0D0D). This section returns to the base dark surface, creating rhythm contrast against the Backstage Charcoal stats band. Vertical padding: 80px top, 80px bottom.

SECTION HEADER (left-aligned on desktop, NOT centered — resist symmetry):
— Eyebrow: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E). Text: 'WHY BOLTWORKS'. Margin-bottom 12px.
— Headline: Archivo Black, 56px on desktop / 40px on tablet / 32px on mobile, uppercase, tracking -0.02em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF). Text: 'MORE THAN A CLUB — IT'S A MOVEMENT'. Max-width 720px.
— Subheadline: Archivo Regular, 18px, line-height 1.65, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC), set 16px below headline, max-width 600px. Text: 'Every session, every build, every match is a step toward something bigger.'
— Margin below header block to card grid: 48px.

CARD GRID: 2 columns × 2 rows on desktop and tablet, 1 column on mobile. Column gap: 24px. Row gap: 24px.

Each card:
— Background: Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A).
— Top-edge rule: 4px solid horizontal line at the very top of each card. Color cycles through the four saturated accents by card position: Card 1 (Hands-On Building) → Reactor Yellow (#FFE600); Card 2 (Live Competition) → Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E); Card 3 (Code That Moves) → Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF); Card 4 (Mentor Network) → Ignition Orange (#FF5C00). This lineup-block top-edge rule is the section's structural device.
— Internal padding: 32px all sides.
— Card title: Archivo Black, 24px, uppercase, tracking -0.01em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF). Margin-bottom 12px.
— Small tag chip above the title: Bebas Neue, 10px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em, same color as the card's top-edge rule, on a transparent background with a 1px border in that color. Chip labels: 'BUILD' / 'COMPETE' / 'CODE' / 'MENTOR'. Margin-bottom 8px.
— Body text: Archivo Regular, 16px, line-height 1.65, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC).
— No card border-radius — sharp corners only, committing to the poster aesthetic's hard borders and flat blocks.
— On hover: the top-edge rule expands to 6px and the card background shifts to a slightly lighter Backstage Charcoal at 10% brightness increase. No shadow — flat poster aesthetic.

CTA ROW: 40px below the card grid, left-aligned. Single button 'Meet Our Departments': Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) background, Voltage Black text, Archivo Black 15px uppercase, sharp corners, 18px vertical / 32px horizontal padding. On hover: Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E) background.

TIMELINE SECTION — Background: Voltage Black (#0D0D0D). This is the most editorial section on the page, using a vertical-spine layout with alternating left/right content blocks to break from the grid rhythm established by the stats and feature sections. Vertical padding: 80px top, 80px bottom.

SECTION HEADER (centered on desktop for this section only — the timeline's bilateral symmetry structurally justifies centering here):
— Eyebrow: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, Ignition Orange (#FF5C00). Text: 'SEASON CALENDAR'. Margin-bottom 12px.
— Headline: Archivo Black, 56px on desktop / 40px on mobile, uppercase, tracking -0.02em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF), centered. Text: 'THE ROAD TO THE CHAMPIONSHIP'.
— Subheadline: Archivo Regular, 18px, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC), centered, max-width 560px, margin 0 auto, 16px below headline. Text: 'Every great robot has a build season. Here's ours.'
— Margin below header to timeline spine: 56px.

TIMELINE SPINE: A vertical 3px line in Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) runs down the horizontal center of the content area on desktop. Each of the 5 items is a node on this spine.

NODE DESIGN: Each node is a large circular badge, 64px diameter, centered on the spine line. Background: Ignition Orange (#FF5C00). Inside the badge: Bebas Neue, 14px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em, Voltage Black text showing the month abbreviation (e.g., 'SEP', 'OCT–NOV', 'DEC', 'JAN–FEB', 'MAR').

CONTENT BLOCKS: Items alternate left and right of the spine. Odd items (1, 3, 5) have content to the LEFT of the spine (right-aligned text, right-edge flush to 40px left of spine). Even items (2, 4) have content to the RIGHT (left-aligned text, left-edge flush to 40px right of spine). On mobile and tablet, collapse to a left-rail spine with all content to the right.

Each content block:
— Title: Archivo Black, 22px, uppercase, tracking -0.01em, Crowd White (#FFFFFF). Margin-bottom 8px.
— Description: Archivo Regular, 16px, line-height 1.65, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC). Max-width 340px per block.
— Vertical spacing between nodes: 64px.

Timeline items:
1. 'SEPTEMBER — KICKOFF RALLY' / 'New members are welcomed, teams are formed, and the season theme is revealed in a festival-style launch event.' — LEFT block.
2. 'OCTOBER–NOVEMBER — BUILD SEASON' / 'Teams enter intensive design and fabrication sprints, guided by mentors and fueled by caffeine and creativity.' — RIGHT block.
3. 'DECEMBER — INTERNAL SHOWCASE' / 'A mid-season exhibition where every team demonstrates their robot's progress and receives peer feedback.' — LEFT block.
4. 'JANUARY–FEBRUARY — REGIONAL QUALIFIERS' / 'BoltWorks teams compete in regional robotics tournaments to earn berths in the state championship.' — RIGHT block.
5. 'MARCH — STATE CHAMPIONSHIP' / 'The biggest stage of the season. Our top teams battle for the title in front of a packed arena.' — LEFT block.

CTA: 56px below the final timeline node, centered. Button 'Get Involved': 2px solid Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) border, transparent background, Reactor Yellow text, Archivo Black 15px uppercase, sharp corners, 18px vertical / 32px horizontal padding. On hover: fills Reactor Yellow background, text switches to Voltage Black.

CTA CLOSE SECTION — This is the loudest color moment on the entire page and a deliberate palette inversion: the background is full-bleed Reactor Yellow (#FFE600), breaking every prior dark-surface section. This is the festival-poster equivalent of the headliner announcement card — a single saturated panel that commands attention and drives action.

BACKGROUND: Full-bleed Reactor Yellow (#FFE600). The circuit-board pattern asset is placed BEHIND all text content as a full-bleed background texture layer at 12% opacity in Voltage Black (#0D0D0D). The pattern's diagonal lines and spark motifs are visible as subtle texture that reinforces the maker-culture identity without competing with the dark type on yellow. The asset covers the entire section surface — not tucked into a corner.

LAYOUT: Centered composition. Vertical padding: 96px top, 96px bottom. Maximum content width: 800px, centered.

EYEBROW: Bebas Neue, 12px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.22em, Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) at 60% opacity (slightly muted against the bright yellow to avoid competing with the headline). Text: 'DOORS ARE OPEN'. Margin-bottom 16px.

HEADLINE: Archivo Black, 80px on desktop / 52px on tablet / 40px on mobile, fully uppercase, tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.92, Voltage Black (#0D0D0D). Text: 'YOUR FIRST BUILD STARTS NOW'. This is the largest dark-on-light type moment on the page — the inversion of the hero's white-on-black creates maximum visual contrast and signals closure.

SUBHEADLINE: Archivo Black, 22px, uppercase, tracking -0.01em, Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) at 80% opacity. Set 20px below headline. Text: 'SPOTS FILL FAST EVERY SEASON. DON'T MISS THE NEXT KICKOFF.'

CTA ROW: 40px below subheadline, centered, two buttons side by side (stacked on mobile, 16px gap between).
— Primary CTA 'Reserve Your Spot': Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) background, Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) text, Archivo Black 15px uppercase, sharp corners, 20px vertical / 36px horizontal padding. On hover: background shifts to Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E), text stays Reactor Yellow.
— Secondary CTA 'Explore Research Projects': 2px solid Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) border, transparent background, Voltage Black text, same type treatment. On hover: border and text shift to Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E).

No section divider below — the page ends here. The yellow panel is the terminal block, and its abrupt edge against any footer surface (Backstage Charcoal) creates the final hard-border poster cut. The circuit-board pattern placement behind the text reinforces that this is a maker-culture brand, not a generic education landing page.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The About page for BoltWorks is a high-energy editorial poster experience — a visual narrative that unfolds like the inside spread of a festival program, not a corporate "about us" page. The page reads as a single continuous scroll of loud typography, saturated color blocks, and dense card grids, with deliberate rhythm shifts between tight-packed sections and breathing moments.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: Section 1 (Page Header) contains the page's defining visual stunt — the word "GARAGE" from the headline is set at an enormous display scale (200–240px, Archivo Black, uppercase) in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600), rotated 90° counter-clockwise and pinned to the left edge of the viewport, bleeding off-grid behind the main headline stack and the vintage-poster illustration. The rest of the headline "Born in a _. Built for the World." wraps around this oversized typographic anchor. This is an unmistakably festival-poster move: type-as-image, off-axis, dominating the composition — not tucked in a corner but crossing the panel boundary. It is grounded in the aesthetic's "poster typography," "bold hierarchy," and "expressive / loud" traits, and in the brand's garage-origin narrative.

SECTION SEQUENCE AND RHYTHM:
1. Page Header — Full-bleed Voltage Black surface, asymmetric type composition with the rotated mega-word, illustration overlapping into the section below. Dense, loud, maximum energy.
2. Story Block / Values — Backstage Charcoal surface, two-column split: long editorial body copy left, four values cards right in a tight 2×2 grid. Dense but structured — the card grid layout family's "compact summaries" at editorial scale. Plasma Magenta top-edge rule on each card.
3. Team Grid — Voltage Black surface, four team member cards in a 4-column horizontal lineup block, styled like festival lineup announcements (role as eyebrow badge, name as headline). Ignition Orange border on card top edges. CTA below the grid, left-aligned.
4. Stats — Full-bleed Plasma Magenta → Reactor Yellow diagonal gradient panel (the loudest color moment on the page). Four oversized stat numerals in Archivo Black at 96px, Crowd White. The radial bar chart asset sits right-side, large, overlapping the stat columns. This section breaks the dark-surface alternation intentionally.
5. CTA Close — Voltage Black surface, centered masthead-style composition. Headline in Reactor Yellow at 72px. Dual CTAs side by side. Tight vertical padding — a punchy, high-contrast close.

COLOR AND SURFACE LOGIC:
- Sections 1, 3, 5: Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) — the dominant dark stage floor.
- Section 2: Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A) — subtle depth shift from section 1.
- Section 4: Full-bleed Plasma Magenta → Reactor Yellow diagonal gradient — the saturated break that makes the stats feel celebratory, not corporate.
- Reactor Yellow is used expressively: the mega-word in section 1, stat numerals in section 4, the section 5 headline — not just on CTAs and eyebrows.
- Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF) appears as tag/badge chips on team cards in section 3 and as the chart accent in section 4.
- Ignition Orange borders and node markers appear in sections 3 and 2.
- Poster Cream (#F5F0DC) is used for body copy text on dark surfaces and card interiors in section 2.

TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY:
- All headings: Archivo Black, uppercase, ultra-tight tracking (-0.03em), Crowd White or Reactor Yellow.
- Eyebrow labels: Bebas Neue, 12px, 0.2em letter-spacing, uppercase, in the accent color relevant to the section.
- Body copy: Archivo Regular, 17px, 1.65 line-height, Poster Cream on dark surfaces.
- Stats: Archivo Black, 96px, Crowd White on gradient.
- Team card names: Archivo Black, 22–26px, Crowd White.
- Role badges: Bebas Neue, 11px, 0.25em letter-spacing, Circuit Cyan background chip.

DENSITY / WHITESPACE LOGIC:
- Section 1: Maximum density — overlapping type, illustration, no breathing room, festival-poster energy.
- Section 2: Medium-dense — editorial column left, tight card grid right. Generous internal card padding.
- Section 3: Medium — card grid with clear gutters, not cramped.
- Section 4: Sparse within the gradient — stats breathe against the bold color, chart commands the right half.
- Section 5: Tight vertical — minimal padding, punchy close.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR:
- Section 1: Rotated mega-word scales to 120px on tablet, hidden on mobile; headline stack goes full-width single-column.
- Section 2: Two-column split collapses to single column (body copy above, values cards below in 2-column grid) on tablet; single column on mobile.
- Section 3: 4-column team grid → 2-column on tablet → single column on mobile.
- Section 4: Stats 4-column → 2×2 on tablet → single column on mobile; chart moves below stats on mobile.
- Section 5: CTA buttons stack vertically on mobile.

This page fits the shared design system by using all defined color tokens expressively, both heading and accent fonts at their specified scales, and the card grid layout family's repeating tile logic — while distinguishing itself through the rotated typographic signature, the diagonal gradient break, and the lineup-block team card treatment that feel specific to the festival-poster aesthetic and the BoltWorks brand voice.

section_design_plans.nl_prompt:
PAGE HEADER — Section type: page_header. Full-bleed Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) background, 100vw × auto height, minimum 80vh. No symmetric centering — this is a deliberately asymmetric, off-grid composition.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The word 'GARAGE' is set in Archivo Black at 220px, fully uppercase, in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600), rotated 90° counter-clockwise. It is absolutely positioned, pinned to the left edge of the viewport, vertically centered within the section, bleeding off-screen at both the top and bottom edges. It sits behind the main content stack (z-index lower) but is fully visible — it functions as a typographic architectural element, not decoration. On tablet it scales to 130px; on mobile it is hidden entirely.

MAIN CONTENT: Positioned in a 12-column grid. The content stack occupies columns 4–11 (right-biased, leaving the left zone for the mega-word), top-aligned with 120px top padding.

Eyebrow: Bebas Neue, 12px, 0.22em letter-spacing, uppercase, Plasma Magenta (#FF1F8E). Text: 'Our Story'.

Headline: 'Born in a Garage. Built for the World.' — Archivo Black, 80px, uppercase, ultra-tight tracking (-0.03em), Crowd White (#FFFFFF). The word 'Garage' in the headline itself is set in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) to echo the mega-word behind it, creating a deliberate call-and-response between the two instances of the word at radically different scales. Line-break after 'Garage.' so 'Built for the World.' sits on its own line.

Subheadline: 'BoltWorks started with five kids, a pile of spare parts, and an unstoppable idea.' — Archivo Regular, 20px, 1.5 line-height, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC). Set beneath the headline with 24px top margin.

Body: Archivo Regular, 17px, 1.65 line-height, Poster Cream (#F5F0DC), max-width 520px, 20px top margin.

ILLUSTRATION ASSET: The vintage-poster garage illustration is placed in the bottom-right of the section, spanning columns 9–12, its bottom edge overlapping 80px into section 2 below (negative margin overlap), reinforcing the festival-poster aesthetic of elements crossing panel boundaries. The illustration has a slight Plasma Magenta duotone overlay at 30% opacity to unify it with the palette. It is 420px wide, auto height.

No CTAs in this section. Bottom of section has a 2px Reactor Yellow horizontal rule spanning full width, acting as a structural divider that doubles as a visual 'stage edge.'

STORY BLOCK — Section type: story_block. Background: Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A), full-width, 120px top padding (accounting for the illustration overlap from section 1), 100px bottom padding.

## Departments Page — Full Visual Design Instruction

### Page Identity & Signature Moment
The **signature moment** lives in Section 2 (the six-department card grid) and is a **full-bleed typographic lineup block**: the word "DEPARTMENTS" is set in Bebas Neue at an extreme display scale (approximately 180–220px) in Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) at 8% opacity, stretching the full viewport width behind the card grid as a ghosted watermark — exactly like a festival poster's background headliner typography. The cards sit on top of this ghost text, which bleeds off both left and right edges of the viewport. This move is directly traceable to the festival_poster visual_cue of "lineup blocks" and "poster typography," and it makes the grid feel like a concert bill rather than a product catalog. It is loud, structural, and unmistakably BoltWorks.

### Section Sequence & Rhythm
The page alternates between dense/high-energy and moderately sparse sections, never repeating the same skeleton twice:

1. **Section 1 — Page Header**: Full-bleed masthead panel. Voltage Black background. Asymmetric type composition with a massive left-anchored H1 and a right-column body block. Six department icons arranged in a horizontal strip across the bottom edge of the panel, bleeding into Section 2.
2. **Section 2 — Item Grid**: Voltage Black background continuing from Section 1. The ghost-text signature moment sits behind the 3×2 card grid. Cards alternate Backstage Charcoal and Voltage Black surfaces with Ignition Orange top-edge rules. Dense, no decorative whitespace.
3. **Section 3 — Comparison**: A dramatic full-bleed Plasma Magenta-to-Ignition Orange diagonal gradient panel. Four division cards arranged as a horizontal row of tall, narrow "event pass" tiles — a side-tabbed/lineup-block structure, not a standard comparison table. High contrast with Crowd White text. Breaks the dark-surface run with a saturated color explosion.
4. **Section 4 — Testimonials**: Returns to Backstage Charcoal. Three testimonial blocks in a staggered asymmetric grid — not equal columns. The festival-wristband illustration sits overlapping the top-left corner of the section, crossing the boundary from Section 3. Pull-quote typography at oversized scale.
5. **Section 5 — CTA Closer**: Voltage Black panel. Full-bleed Reactor Yellow horizontal band containing the headline in Archivo Black at H1 scale in Voltage Black — a type-as-color-block moment. Two CTA buttons side by side, left-aligned.

### Color & Surface Logic
- Sections 1, 2, 4, 5: Dark surfaces (Voltage Black / Backstage Charcoal) — the "stage floor" majority of the page.
- Section 3: Saturated gradient explosion (Plasma Magenta → Ignition Orange) — the one bold color break that prevents monotony and reinforces the festival-poster palette_mood of "bright gradients."
- Reactor Yellow (#FFE600) appears as: ghost display text (Section 2), badge numerals (Section 3), CTA button fill (Section 5), and eyebrow label accents throughout.
- Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF) appears as metadata chip backgrounds on department cards and division comparison tags.
- Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) appears as card top-edge rules (Section 2), gradient anchor (Section 3), and timeline-node-style bullet markers (Section 4).
- Poster Cream (#F5F0DC) is used for body copy text on all dark surfaces and for card description text.

### Typographic Hierarchy
- H1 (Section 1 headline): Archivo Black, 80–96px, fully uppercase, ultra-tight tracking (-0.03em), Crowd White.
- H2 (Section 2, 3, 5 headlines): Archivo Black, 48–60px, uppercase, Crowd White or Voltage Black (Section 5 on yellow band).
- H3 (card/tile titles): Archivo Black, 28–32px, uppercase, Crowd White or Reactor Yellow.
- Body: Archivo Regular, 16–18px, 1.65 line-height, Poster Cream on dark surfaces.
- Eyebrows: Bebas Neue, 12–14px, uppercase, 0.2em letter-spacing, Reactor Yellow or Circuit Cyan.
- Metadata chips: Bebas Neue, 11px, uppercase, 0.15em letter-spacing, on Circuit Cyan chip backgrounds in Voltage Black text.
- Ghost watermark: Bebas Neue, 180–220px, Reactor Yellow at 8% opacity.

### Density / Whitespace Logic
Sections 1 and 2 are deliberately dense — minimal padding, the icon strip bleeds between them, the ghost text fills dead space. Section 3 is tight but uses the gradient color itself as breathing room. Section 4 has more generous vertical padding to let the pull-quote typography land. Section 5 is intentionally lean — the Reactor Yellow band is the entire visual event.

### Responsive Behavior
- Mobile: Section 1 collapses to a single column; icon strip becomes a 3×2 grid. Section 2 cards stack to a single column; ghost text scales to 80px and remains behind. Section 3 division tiles stack vertically. Section 4 testimonials stack single-column with the wristband illustration pinned to top. Section 5 CTA buttons stack vertically.
- Tablet: Section 2 becomes a 2×3 grid. Section 3 tiles become a 2×2 grid. Section 4 uses a 2-column stagger.
- Desktop: All layouts as specified in section plans.

### Fit Within Shared Design System
This page uses the full BoltWorks palette and type system as defined. It does not introduce any new colors or fonts. The festival-poster aesthetic is pushed to maximum amplitude through the ghost-text watermark, the gradient explosion in Section 3, the wristband illustration crossing section boundaries, and the Reactor Yellow full-bleed CTA band — all traceable to the design_aesthetic's visual_cues (lineup blocks, bold gradients, large date badges, poster typography) and the layout_family's structure_cues (repeated cards, tile grids, filter-like rows, compact summaries).

The Research page for BoltWorks is a festival-poster editorial showcase — a "stage" for student innovation that reads like a science-fair program designed by a concert promoter. The page uses Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) as its primary surface throughout, broken only by a full-bleed Plasma Magenta-to-Reactor Yellow gradient band in the stats section and a Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A) alternating surface for the gallery. Every section has a distinct skeleton so no two feel templated.

SECTION RHYTHM & SEQUENCE:
1. Page Header — Masthead-style, full-bleed, asymmetric split with oversized poster typography dominating the left column and the robot-arm illustration bleeding off the right edge. Dense and loud.
2. Article List (Active Projects) — Dense card-grid index: 2-column card grid on dark surface, each card structured like a lineup block with a bold project-name headline, status badge, and metadata strip. CTA anchored at the bottom of the section.
3. Stats — Full-bleed Plasma Magenta → Reactor Yellow gradient panel. Oversized numerals in Archivo Black at 120–144px anchor each stat. Department bar chart sits to the right as a secondary visual block. This is the page's SIGNATURE MOMENT.
4. Gallery (Hall of Bolts) — Backstage Charcoal surface. Milestone cards arranged as a staggered 2×2 tile grid with large date badges (Reactor Yellow circles) overlapping the card top-left corner — a classic festival-poster "lineup block" treatment. Asymmetric vertical rhythm with alternating card heights.

pages.page_level_design_instruction:
The Contact page for BoltWorks is a five-section festival-poster composition on a Voltage Black (#0D0D0D) base that treats reaching out as a high-voltage event rather than a bureaucratic form. The page oscillates between dense, information-packed panels and sparse, explosive typographic moments — a deliberate loud-quiet-loud rhythm that mirrors a festival lineup sheet.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: Section 2 (contact_block) contains the page-defining move — a full-bleed, two-column asymmetric split where the left column is a saturated Plasma Magenta-to-Reactor Yellow diagonal gradient panel housing the contact form, and the right column is a Voltage Black info-card stack. The form's "Send a Message" CTA is a massive Reactor Yellow bar spanning the full form width with Archivo Black uppercase text at 24px. The section headline "WE RESPOND WITHIN 24 HOURS" is set in Archivo Black at 72px in Reactor Yellow, overflowing its column boundary and partially underlapping the gradient panel edge — a classic festival-poster headline bleed that makes the type feel structural rather than decorative. This move is aesthetically inevitable: festival posters always let their most important promise dominate the layout at maximum scale.

SECTION RHYTHM:
1. Page Header — full-bleed dark stage with oversized display type and a centered illustration bleeding into the grid; sparse and theatrical.
2. Contact Block — the signature moment; maximum density, asymmetric two-column split, diagonal gradient, overflowing headline.
3. Map Block — flat-graphic illustrated map dominates the upper half, bold lineup-style text block below; mid-density.
4. FAQ — dense accordion-style index block on Backstage Charcoal, typeset like a festival schedule board; tight and information-rich.
5. CTA Close — full-bleed Reactor Yellow panel, single massive Archivo Black headline, two CTA buttons; loud and conclusive.

COLOR SURFACE LOGIC: Sections alternate Voltage Black → gradient split → Voltage Black → Backstage Charcoal (#1E1E2A) → Reactor Yellow (#FFE600), creating a deliberate escalation toward the yellow finale. Circuit Cyan (#00E5FF) is used for metadata chips (email type, hours type) in Section 2 and for FAQ category eyebrows. Ignition Orange (#FF5C00) marks card top-edge rules and form field focus borders. Poster Cream (#F5F0DC) is used exclusively for body copy and form field backgrounds in Section 2 and FAQ answer text.

TYPOGRAPHY: Every section heading is Archivo Black uppercase. Eyebrows are Bebas Neue at 12px with 0.2em letter-spacing in the appropriate accent color. Body copy is Archivo Regular 16–18px on Poster Cream or Crowd White surfaces. Section 2's overflowing headline at 72px is the typographic peak; Section 5's headline at 80–96px on yellow is the emotional peak. No heading drops below 800 weight.

DENSITY LOGIC: Sections 1 and 5 are sparse and theatrical (high padding, few elements). Sections 2 and 4 are dense and information-heavy (tight internal spacing, compact card stacks). Section 3 is mid-density with the map dominating the visual mass.

RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR: On mobile, the two-column split in Section 2 stacks vertically (gradient form panel on top, info cards below). The map in Section 3 becomes full-width and scrollable. FAQ items in Section 4 remain full-width accordion rows. The overflowing headline in Section 2 scales down to 48px and stays within its column boundary on mobile. The Reactor Yellow finale in Section 5 remains full-bleed at all breakpoints.

This page fits the shared design system by using all eight palette tokens expressively, maintaining the Archivo Black / Bebas Neue / Archivo typographic trio, and channeling the festival-poster energy through poster typography, lineup blocks, bold gradients, and large date/badge-style treatments — consistent with the system while delivering a contact experience that feels like an event invitation rather than a support form.
